title: A tab box at a narrow width can show no tab name
body:
A box of tabbed fences (`Part::Tabs` in `ui.rs`) draws its tab names on the header row after the language, and `fitting_tabs` keeps the names that fit, with a `+N` word for the rest. The `render raw` and `wrap pan` words keep their room first. At about 34 columns a `rust` box with two tabs drew `┌ rust   +2   wrap pan   ⧉`, with no tab name, so nothing says which tab is shown.

## Proposal

The shown tab's name always appears, cut with `…` when it has to be. The other toggle words give up room before it does.
